text:
releasebot: Hotfix queued: embed-throttle-adjust -> canary. Change window 01:40-02:00 UTC. Trigger: bursts causing embed workers to return 503s. Paging @oncall SRE.

morgan: i'm oncall for that window. request: expedited roll to 30% after a short burn if metrics look good. need to cut customer impact now. :rotating_light: 

tai: eng +1. Patch is a small throttle + atomic update to cache. Image sha must be pinned to 9ab4c3d. No infra/db changes.

sre_lee: standing by. abort criteria: errors > 0.9% sustained 1m OR p99 > 275ms. keep APAC traffic on stable until we confirm.

pm_zoe: tagging product for visibility — this reduces error surface for customers using async embeds.

morgan: ops runbook snippet:
```
# deploy canary
deploybot deploy --env=canary --image=redwood/hotfix:9ab4c3d
# health probes
kubectl exec -c probe -- curl -fsS http://svc.internal/health || exit 1
# quick rollback
deploybot rollback --to-sha=prev-3344
```

opsbot: preflight checks: image present, infra quotas OK, canary nodes available, no blocking alerts.

deploybot: Canary rollout started (2 pods, sha 9ab4c3d). Opening ephemeral alert channel.

sre_lee: watching dashboards. setting temporary SLO hold.

opsbot: canary minute 1: errors 0.4%, p99 120ms. minute 2: errors 0.25%, p99 128ms. burn-in passed (2m).

morgan: initiating fast-roll to 30% prod traffic. pinning image.

tai: confirming no model or tokenizer changes. good to fastcut.

opsbot: post-cut quick checks: 2m rolling avg errors 0.22%, p99 140ms. no pages triggered. monitoring for 12m.

sre_lee: APAC still isolated; i'll approve final widen once APAC metrics show similar.

opsbot: +8m: errors 0.19%, p99 145ms. APAC load shown separately: errors 0.15%, p99 150ms.

pm_zoe: noted. drafting short release blurb: "hotfix: tune embed throttle + atomic cache write to prevent transient 503s under burst load. pinned sha 9ab4c3d." link: https://docs.internal/releases/1724800000-embed-throttle

tai: +1 release owner. will schedule rel-train merge after full widen.

morgan: if no regressions in the 12m window i'll request close and archive ephemeral channel.

deploybot: Fastcut to 30% complete. Holding for observation window.

sre_lee: ok to widen globally after one additional 5m check from APAC.

opsbot: final check +5m: errors 0.17%, p99 148ms. no alerts in channel.

morgan: thanks team — widening to full rollout now. closing ephemeral channel in 2. :white_check_mark:
